comparison_contract: Every cell uses the same treatment-independent record IDs and the same decoded prefix of vectors from the checksum-pinned official Cohere Medium 1M train Parquet before starting any durable-ticket timer. Each writer is one separately opened library instance sharing the same collection; producer-thread-only evidence is invalid. Each instance owns one persisted writer stripe. Writer count and logical-cell count are independent matrix factors and writer order rotates across repetitions. Each acknowledgement is the public lane-log durability boundary and its authoritative HEAD must remain below 2 MiB. The complete physical storage trace, including post-acknowledgement spill and drain I/O, is preserved separately from acknowledgement request accounting. The 1,000 operations per writer cross repeated background-materialization boundaries; both acknowledgement throughput and end-to-end throughput through the final drain must reach 10,000 vectors/s in preregistered 32-writer cells. Write p95 applies to every cell. Before drain, 20 refresh-plus-search probes must preserve inserted-ID recall@10 and remain below the same 200 ms read-p95 gate, explicitly measuring mutable-HEAD refresh cost; post-drain reads repeat the gate. These synthetic-base inserted-ID checks are visibility/read-path invariants, not corpus ANN recall or the production read-latency qualification. Five paired repetitions qualify architecture only; publication requires a separately frozen campaign from the selected revision.
